availableBytes.description: What the kernel estimates new programs can get without swapping (the ARC not included).

memory.description:
Physical memory split the way the monitor draws it. On Linux the ZFS ARC is not part of the page cache, so the
kernel counts it as used; UsedBytes leaves it out and ArcBytes shows it.

network.description: Every interface except the loopback and container links.

busyPercent.description: Share of the second with at least one request in flight, 0 to 100.

disks.description: Every whole disk (no partitions, zvols or loop devices).

chip.description: The hwmon chip or thermal zone type, for example `coretemp`, `nvme` or `acpitz`.

label.description: The sensor's label (`Package id 0`, `Composite`), or null when the driver gives none.

highCelsius.description: The driver's high mark, if any.

criticalCelsius.description: The driver's critical mark, if any.

temperatures.description: Every sensor found; empty where the hardware or a virtual machine has none.

oneOf.description: One second of the box, the event of `system/resources`. Rates are per second since the previous sample.

latest.description: One second of the box, the event of `system/resources`. Rates are per second since the previous sample.

ResourceSnapshot.description: Snapshot of `system/resources`: what the box is and the last hour, as far as someone watched it.

layout.description: The layout now saved for this device.

version.description: Its version, for `If-Match` on the next save.

recoveryKey.description: Shown exactly once. It is the only way to reset the administrator password.

required.description: True until the first administrator exists.

hostname.description: Shown on the setup and sign-in screens, so users with several servers know where they sign in.

description.description: Free text for administrators and users, may be empty.

path.description: The share root on the host.

pool.description: The pool of the share's dataset; null for a folder share.

dataset.description: Full name of the share's dataset, for example `tank/pithyx/shares/media`; null for a folder share (development only).

usedBytes.description: Space the dataset uses with its snapshots; null for a folder share or while the dataset is not there (pool missing).

availableBytes.description: Space still available to the dataset; null like UsedBytes.

quotaBytes.description: The dataset's quota, or null for none.

readUsers.description: Users other than administrators who may read.

readWriteUsers.description: Users other than administrators who may read and write.

ShareDetails.description: A share with what the Shared folders page shows. Administrators only.

id.description: Stable id; file paths are relative to the share.

access.description: The user's access: read or read and write.

path.description: The share root on the host. Only administrators get it.

ShareInfo.description: A share the user can use.

revision.description: Changes whenever a user's list of usable shares may have changed; compare it, do not count on it.

name.description: Name of the new shared folder; its dataset name is derived from it and shown in the plan.

pool.description: Pool of the new shared folder; it needs the Pithyx layout (`<pool>/pithyx/shares`).

description.description: Description of the new shared folder.

confirmName.description: The shared folder's name, typed by the user to delete it.

oneOf.description: `keep` leaves the dataset or folder with its files, `destroy` destroys the dataset and its snapshots (dataset shares only).

SharePlanRequest.description:
A shared folder action to plan. `share.create` needs Name and Pool (Description is optional);
`share.delete` needs ShareId, ConfirmName and Data.

name.description: New name shown to users, unique like every share name.

description.description: New description, at most 200 characters, empty to remove it.

ShareUpdate.description: Changes of a share; fields left out stay. The dataset is never renamed by this.

administrator.description: Administrators use every share with read and write access, whatever Access says.

ShareUserAccess.description: One user's access to a share, for editing rights.

state.description:
`passed`, `warning` (reallocated, pending or uncorrectable sectors, media errors or a failed self-test),
`failed` (the drive predicts its failure), `unsupported` (no SMART, see Reason) or
`unknown` (not read yet, asleep since the daemon started, or the read failed).

reason.description:
For `unsupported`: `virtual` (a disk of a virtual machine) or `not_available`. For `unknown`:
`asleep`, `not_read` or `read_failed`. Otherwise null.

asleep.description: True when the last check found the disk asleep; the values are then from ReadAt.

mediaErrors.description: NVMe media and data integrity errors.

criticalWarning.description: NVMe critical warning bits; not 0 means the drive reports a critical condition.

lastSelfTest.description: Result of the newest self-test: `passed`, `failed`, `aborted` or `running`; null without one.

readAt.description: When SMART data was last read (UTC); null if never.

checkedAt.description: When the disk was last checked (UTC), including checks that found it asleep.

SmartReport.description: SMART health of one disk as last read. The API serves it from memory; reading it never runs a command.

dataset.description: The dataset the snapshot belongs to, for example `tank/pithyx/shares/media`.

createdAt.description: When ZFS took it (UTC), by the clock the box had then.

holds.description: Number of holds (`userrefs`); a held snapshot cannot be destroyed.

createTxg.description: The transaction group it was taken in: the order of snapshots, whatever the clock said.

pithyxKind.description: The schedule kind of a snapshot Pithyx created, or null for every other snapshot.

SnapshotMessage.description: The full current state of a topic, sent after `sub`. Only changes follow as events.

keep.description: How many of its snapshots it keeps (1 to 1000).

schedules.description: One entry per kind; kinds left out of a PUT stay as they are.

SnapshotScheduleList.description: Schedules of a dataset: all four kinds, in the order hourly, daily, weekly, monthly.

key.description: Stable key of the cause, for example `pool.degraded:tank` or `disk.smart_failed:wwn-0x5000c500a1b2c3d4`.

since.description: When the daemon first saw the cause (UTC); a restart starts it again.

muted.description: True when the user muted this alert at this severity or higher.

StorageAlert.description: A storage problem that exists now. Alerts are derived from the current state, never stored.

StorageDisk.description: A disk with the guard's verdict, for the Storage settings page.

environment.description: `dev` or `prod`; on dev only the declared test disks can be used.

alerts.description: Current alerts, critical first, with the user's mute flags.

StorageHealth.description: Snapshot and event of `storage/alerts`, and response of `GET /api/storage/alerts`.

planId.description:
Runs the plan exactly as shown with `POST /api/storage/plans/{planId}/run`; null while a disk is not allowed, and
while RequiresConfirmName is true and the name was not typed yet.

disks.description: The guard's verdict for every chosen disk, after probing them again.

commands.description: The exact commands, or null while a disk is not allowed.

datasets.description:
For destroying or exporting a pool: every dataset that goes or becomes unavailable; for `pool.import`: the
datasets it mounts. For destroying a dataset: the dataset, its children and every snapshot of them
(`dataset@snapshot`), each dataset followed by its snapshots. For renaming a dataset: the dataset and its
children, whose names change. For destroying a snapshot: the snapshot (`dataset@snapshot`); for rolling back:
every newer snapshot, which goes too.

expiresAt.description: Until when the plan may run.

warnings.description:
Stable codes for what the user must know before running it: `lowers_redundancy`, `replication_mismatch`,
`irreversible` and `no_redundancy` (adding a vdev: it tolerates fewer failed disks than the pool, it has a
layout ZFS calls a replication mismatch, it can never be removed, it has no redundancy), `irreversible` (RAID-Z
expansion), `other_system` (an import forced over another system's claim), `degraded` (the pool is imported
with devices missing), `unmounted_datasets` (Unmounted stay unmounted) and
`datasets_unavailable` (exporting a pool with datasets in use); for a rollback `changes_lost` (every change
since the snapshot is lost) and `newer_snapshots` (the listed newer snapshots are destroyed).

requiresConfirmName.description: True when the plan runs only with the pool's name (for a rollback the dataset's full name) typed in `confirmName`.

unmounted.description: For `pool.import`: datasets that stay unmounted, and why; those that would hide part of the system also get `canmount=noauto`.

pool.description: The pool, or the new pool's name; for `pool.import.readonly` the scanned name (the GUID decides).

diskIds.description: The disks to use, by id.

name.description: Name of a new volume (one path component), or the snapshot after `@` for the snapshot actions. Shared folders are created with `POST /api/shares/plans`.

vdev.description: GUID of the device to replace, take offline, bring online or remove, or of the raidz vdev to expand.

encryption.description: The answer to the encryption question of a new pool: `none`, or `key` once the key vault exists.

confirmName.description: The pool's name, or the dataset's full name, typed by the user where the preview says `requiresConfirmName` and to destroy.

confirmations.description: Serial numbers the user typed, by disk id.

dataset.description: Full name of the dataset or volume to rename, change or destroy, on Pool.

newName.description: The new last component of a renamed dataset (it stays below the same parent), or for `pool.import.readonly` the name to import the pool under when its own is taken.

quotaBytes.description: New quota in bytes (dataset, children and snapshots), 0 for none; null leaves it.

reservationBytes.description: New reservation in bytes (dataset, children and snapshots), 0 for none; null leaves it.

compression.description: New compression: `off`, `lz4`, `zle`, `zstd`, `zstd-1` to `zstd-19`, `gzip`, `gzip-1` to `gzip-9`; null leaves it.

recordSizeBytes.description: New record size of a file system, a power of two from 4 KiB to 1 MiB; null leaves it.

sizeBytes.description: Size of a new volume, at least 1 MiB; rounded up to whole 16 KiB blocks.

sparse.description: True for a volume that reserves no space up front.

poolGuid.description: For `pool.import.readonly`: the pool's numeric identifier from the import scan.

force.description: For imports: import a pool that was last used by another system; needs ConfirmName.

target.description: The pool name for scrubs; empty for self-tests, which cover every disk with SMART.

lastRunAt.description: When it last ran (UTC); for self-tests the oldest of all disks. Null if never.

nextRunAt.description: When it runs next (UTC); null when it is off or has nothing to run on.

target.description: The pool name for scrubs; empty for self-tests.

hostname.description: The host name of the box.

cpuPercent.description: Usage since the previous sample; null for the very first one.

memoryAvailableBytes.description: Memory available for new work without swapping, including reclaimable caches.

folder.description: The folder shown, relative to the share.

names.description: Entries of that folder on screen, at most 200.

size.description: `small` (64 px, list rows) or `large` (256 px, grid tiles).

ThumbnailSize.description: The two thumbnail sizes: rows of the list, tiles of the grid (both twice their CSS size for sharp screens).

version.description: For `ready`: changes whenever the file changes; pass it as `v` so a new version is loaded.

topic.description: Subscribe to it for the thumbnails that are still pending.

items.description: One state per distinct name asked for.

ThumbnailStates.description: Response of `POST /api/files/{shareId}/thumbnails`. Nothing was rendered while answering.

ThumbnailStatus.description: Whether a thumbnail can be shown now.

ThumbnailWatch.description: Snapshot of a thumbnail topic; the events carry everything.

status.description: Whether a thumbnail can be shown now.

version.description: For `ready`: changes whenever the file changes; pass it as `v` so a new version is loaded.

items.description: Each with `ready` and its version, or `none`.

size.description: The two thumbnail sizes: rows of the list, tiles of the grid (both twice their CSS size for sharp screens).

ThumbnailsReady.description: Event of `thumbnails/<share>/<folder>`: thumbnails that were rendered or refused.

uri.description: otpauth:// URI for the QR code.

code.description: Six-digit code from the authenticator app.

recoveryCode.description: One of the recovery codes shown when TOTP was enabled, instead of a code.

id.description: Id for restoring or deleting it.

name.description: Its name when it was deleted.

originalPath.description: Where it was, relative to the share; restoring puts it back there.

kind.description: File, folder, symlink or another kind.

size.description: Bytes, for a folder everything inside it.

deletedBy.description: User name of who deleted it, if that user still exists.

expiresAt.description: When it is deleted for good, or null when the share keeps deleted items until emptied.

TrashItem.description: One item in a share's recycle bin.

ids.description: Items of the share's recycle bin, at most 1000.

oneOf.description: For restoring: what happens when the original place is taken; rename when left out.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

retentionDays.description: Days the share keeps deleted items; 0 keeps them until the bin is emptied.
0 to 3650; 0 keeps deleted items until the bin is emptied.

reason.description:
Why it stays unmounted: `system_path` (`/` or at or below a system directory), `shadows_mount` (it
would hide something mounted there or below), `duplicate_mountpoint` (another dataset of the pool mounts there
first) or `key_unavailable` (encrypted and locked).

name.description: Vdev name as ZFS shows it: `raidz1-0`, `mirror-1` or the device's by-id name.

vdevGuid.description: Vdev GUID as decimal text; names a device in commands even when it is missing.

type.description: ZFS vdev type: `disk`, `file`, `mirror`, `raidz`, `draid`, `spare`, `replacing` and so on.

role.description: What the vdev is for: `data`, `log`, `cache`, `special`, `dedup` or `spare`.

path.description: Device path of a leaf vdev, usually below `/dev/disk/by-id`.

parityDisks.description: Parity level of a raidz vdev (1 to 3), otherwise null.

readErrors.description: Read errors since import or the last clear.

writeErrors.description: Write errors since import or the last clear.

checksumErrors.description: Checksum errors since import or the last clear.

appId.description: The app the preference belongs to.

width.description: Last free width of the app's windows in CSS pixels.

height.description: Last free height in CSS pixels.
